correctness.rationale: The unique stationary law follows from an irreducible internal CTMC and exponential position contraction. Its three even moments are derived from bounded generator identities. Positivity reduces fixed variance to one open rate interval; a verified rational derivative has exactly one simple interior zero, giving the sharp feasibility and twofold region. Equal fourth and sixth normalized moments at distinct admissible rates force one rate to the forbidden boundary via an invertible two-equation linear system in their sum and product. A generator-based exact rational checker passed 117 checks; numerical samples are supplementary, not the proof.

value.rationale: The two independent residence rates are physical quantities not directly observable from stationary particle locations. The finding gives a complete exact test for two low-order snapshots and proves why variance plus fourth moment can be intrinsically ambiguous, while the sixth moment is enough for globally unique identification. The exact rational twofold witness and full fold geometry make the quantity naturally motivated and nontrivial, though not a claim of noisy-data reliability.
